description: This file defines a generic utility class 'OptionalCompat' that provides a way to handle nullable values with methods for creation, retrieval, and comparison, similar to Java's Optional class.

classes.name: OptionalCompat
classes.description: A generic class that encapsulates an optional value, providing methods to create, access, and compare nullable values.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an OptionalCompat instance with a possibly null value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the contained value if present, otherwise null.

methods.name: isPresent
methods.description: Checks if the value is non-null.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the value is null.

methods.name: getOrElse
methods.description: Returns the contained value if present, otherwise returns the provided default value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare OptionalCompat instances based on their contained values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on the contained value.
